title: codex session continuity — Windows
unhealthy: Background process: not confirmed healthy. See the Windows guide.
desktopOk: Desktop connection: catalog and read-only call verified.
desktopOffline: Desktop connection: offline. Queued requests are preserved.
desktopUnknown: Desktop connection: not reported. A live process alone is not proof of readiness.
maintenance: Maintenance: sending and creation are suspended; requests are retained.
setupNeeded: Not configured. Run install.ps1 with a management task ID first.
pauseHint: OFF pauses automatic handoffs and the compaction hook; local archival continues.
manualHint: A manual request targets only your explicit selection and does not change the automatic switch.
sentHint: Already dispatched operations are not revoked. Closing this menu keeps the current switch.
explicitId: An explicit task ID is required; the active task is never selected automatically.
queued: Manual request queued; the handoff and successor task are NOT yet complete.
offlineQueue: The request is retained until the existing background process is ready. This menu starts no extra process.
progressHint: Automatic mode is unchanged. Use option 3 to check progress; queued is not completed.
noTasks: No local parent tasks are available. Check the desktop app and background process.
selectHint: Selection queues a handoff in the same project and directory. Enter a number, full UUID, or codex://threads/ link.
sort: Order: active first, then latest activity. Times use your local time zone.
invalidChoice: Enter a listed number, full task ID/link, or 0.
blocked: This task cannot be continued; no request was submitted. Select another task or go back.
changed: The switch changed during the operation. Check the current state again.
cliMissing: cli.mjs is missing. Keep this menu with the program files.
nodeMissing: Node.js is missing. Install Node.js 24+ and reopen this menu.
jsonAction: Use -Json with -Action Status, On, Off, or Continue.
operationFailed: Operation failed ({0}, exit {1}). Do not treat it as completed.
